spanish: Y si sobre el lecho él o sobre el utensilio que ella sentante sobre él, en su tocar en él se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: Qal active participle of sit is rendered sentante, the agent form of causative sentar (seat), shifting stem force from sitting to seating.
The infinitive suffix is 3ms, but su does not mark masculine, so the toucher can be read as the woman.
The definite evening noun is rendered tarde, which in current Latin American Spanish also covers the afternoon.

notes: Conjunction, pronouns, articles, qal infinitive, and qal 3ms impurity verb match the tokens.
